evidence.quote: Although we evaluate four models from three different providers, our study still covers only a limited set of representative LLMs rather than the full spectrum of open- and closed-source architectures.
Our evaluation is limited to open-source projects implemented in Python, constraining our ability to demonstrate cross-language effectiveness.

Since LLMs are often trained on open-source repositories, public benchmarks may inadvertently overlap with their training corpora. This raises the risk that evaluation results reflect prior exposure rather than genuine generalization.
issues solved exclusively by DARS highlight a limitation of ExpeRepair: its effectiveness drops when relevant prior experience is unavailable.

Django’s cumulative resolution rate stabilizes around issue 80 at approximately 60%, which may be attributable to diminishing returns from repeated memory and the increasing heterogeneity of the remaining issues.

While our approach improves test generation and patch generation by leveraging accumulated episodic and semantic memories, it currently places less emphasis on optimizing bug localization, which is also a critical factor in program repair performance.
We leave the integration of reliable, memory-based bug localization into our framework as an important direction for future work.
